entry.en: To enter Tonga, your passport must have an expiry date at least 6 months after the date you arrive.
entry.es: Para entrar en Tonga, su pasaporte debe caducar al menos 6 meses después de la fecha de llegada.
entry.quote: To enter Tonga, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: You can visit Tonga for up to 30 days without a pre-arranged visa, and border officials issue a free visa on arrival.
entry.es: Puede visitar Tonga hasta 30 días sin visado previo, y los funcionarios fronterizos expiden un visado gratuito a la llegada.
entry.quote: You can visit Tonga without a pre-arranged visa for up to 30 days. Border officials will issue a free visa on when you arrive.

entry.en: You may need to show an onward or return ticket, sufficient funds and confirmed accommodation.
entry.es: Puede que deba mostrar un billete de continuación o vuelta, fondos suficientes y alojamiento confirmado.
entry.quote:
You may need to show: 

- an onward or return ticket 

- sufficient funds – a bank statement is acceptable evidence

- confirmed accommodation

entry.en: You must declare all plant, animal and food products, and personal valuables worth 500 pa'angas or more.
entry.es: Debe declarar todos los productos vegetales, animales y alimentarios, y los objetos de valor personales de 500 pa'angas o más.
entry.quote:
including all plant, animal and food products. 

You must also declare any personal valuables worth 500 Tongan pa’angas (about £160) or more.

entry.en: Cash or travellers cheques worth more than 10,000 pa'angas must be declared on the customs declaration form.
entry.es: El efectivo o los cheques de viaje de más de 10 000 pa'angas deben declararse en el formulario de aduanas.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques on the customs declaration form if the value is more than 10,000 pa’angas.

safety.en: Serious crime is low, but petty theft is fairly common.
safety.es: El nivel de delincuencia grave es bajo, pero los hurtos menores son bastante comunes.
safety.quote: The level of serious crime is low, but petty theft is fairly common.

safety.en: Topless sunbathing and public nudity are illegal, with a possible fine of up to 100 pa'angas.
safety.es: Tomar el sol en topless y la desnudez en público son ilegales, con una posible multa de hasta 100 pa'angas.
safety.quote: Topless sunbathing and nudity in public is illegal. You could be fined up to 100 pa’angas

safety.en: Same-sex sexual activity between men is illegal in Tonga and the law is occasionally enforced.
safety.es: La actividad sexual entre hombres del mismo sexo es ilegal en Tonga y la ley se aplica ocasionalmente.
safety.quote: Same-sex sexual activity between men is illegal in Tonga and the law is occasionally enforced.

safety.en: Tonga's tides can produce powerful currents in ocean lagoons, and there have been fatal accidents on popular beaches.
safety.es: Las mareas de Tonga pueden producir fuertes corrientes en las lagunas oceánicas y ha habido accidentes mortales en playas populares.
safety.quote: Tonga’s tides can produce powerful currents in ocean lagoons. There have been fatal accidents on popular beaches.

safety.en: Ferries do not follow normal safety regulations and are often overloaded.
safety.es: Los ferris no siguen la normativa de seguridad habitual y a menudo van sobrecargados.
safety.quote: Ferries do not follow normal safety regulations and are often overloaded.

safety.en: The tropical cyclone season normally runs from November to May, but cyclones can happen throughout the year.
safety.es: La temporada de ciclones tropicales suele ir de noviembre a mayo, pero pueden ocurrir durante todo el año.
safety.quote: The tropical cyclone season normally runs from November to May, but cyclones can happen throughout the year.

health.en: Call 933 and ask for an ambulance.
health.es: Llame al 933 y pida una ambulancia.
health.quote: Call 933 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: Health facilities in Tonga are basic, and medical evacuation is required for most non-basic medical problems.
health.es: Los centros sanitarios de Tonga son básicos y la evacuación médica es necesaria para la mayoría de los problemas no básicos.
health.quote: Health facilities in Tonga are basic. The range of drugs available is limited and modern equipment is in short supply. Medical evacuation from Tonga is required for most non-basic medical problems.

health.en: Health risks in Tonga include Zika virus and dengue.
health.es: Los riesgos sanitarios en Tonga incluyen el virus del Zika y el dengue.
health.quote:
See what health risks you’ll face in Tonga, including:  

- Zika virus 

- dengue

health.en: There is no malaria in Tonga.
health.quote: There is no malaria in Tonga though.

health.en: Tap water is generally safe, though its quality might vary by location.
health.es: El agua del grifo suele ser segura, aunque su calidad puede variar según el lugar.
health.quote: Tap water is generally safe, though its quality might vary by location.

help.en: The general emergency number in Tonga is 911.
help.es: El número de emergencias general en Tonga es el 911.

help.en: Police can be reached on 922, fire on 999 and ambulance on 933.
help.es: A la policía se llama al 922, a los bomberos al 999 y a la ambulancia al 933.

getting_in.en: Fua'amotu Airport is the largest airport in Tonga and the only one on Tongatapu.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Fua'amotu es el más grande de Tonga y el único de Tongatapu.
getting_in.quote: Fua'amotu Airport (TBU IATA) is on Tongatapu around half an hour from Nuku'alofa. The largest airport in Tonga and the only one on Tongatapu.

getting_in.en: There are several flights a week from Auckland, Sydney, Suva and Nadi.
getting_in.es: Hay varios vuelos semanales desde Auckland, Sídney, Suva y Nadi.
getting_in.quote: There are several flights a week from Auckland, Sydney, Suva and Nadi.

getting_in.en: Many people arrive by private yacht, since Tonga, particularly Vava'u, is a common stop on the around-the-world circuit.
getting_in.es: Mucha gente llega en yate privado, ya que Tonga, sobre todo Vava'u, es una parada habitual del circuito de la vuelta al mundo.
getting_in.quote: Lots of people arrive by private yacht since Tonga, particularly Vava'u, is a common stop on the around-the-world circuit.

getting_around.en: To get between island groups, you basically have to fly or sail.
getting_around.es: Para ir de un grupo de islas a otro, básicamente hay que volar o navegar.
getting_around.quote: To get between island groups, you basically have to fly (or sail).

getting_around.en: Cars can be hired on Tongatapu, and motorbikes, scooters and cycles can be rented on Tongatapu, Vava'u and Ha'apai.
getting_around.es: En Tongatapu se pueden alquilar coches, y motos, scooters y bicicletas en Tongatapu, Vava'u y Ha'apai.
getting_around.quote: Motorbikes, scooters and cycles can be rented on Tongatapu, Vava'u and Ha'apai. On Tongatapu you can hire a car.

getting_around.en: You're meant to buy a local Tongan driving licence on top of your existing licence before you drive.
getting_around.es: Se supone que hay que comprar un permiso de conducir tongano además del propio antes de conducir.
getting_around.quote: You're meant to also buy a local Tongan driving licence on top of your existing licence before you drive (25 pa'anga).

getting_around.en: There are buses to various points on Tongatapu from Nuku'alofa, but there are no timetables.
getting_around.es: Hay autobuses desde Nuku'alofa a varios puntos de Tongatapu, pero no hay horarios.
getting_around.quote: There are buses to various points on Tongatapu from Nuku'alofa although there are no timetables.

money.en: The national currency is the pa'anga, or Tongan dollar (TOP).
money.es: La moneda nacional es el pa'anga, o dólar tongano (TOP).
money.quote: The national currency is the pa'anga, or Tongan dollar, denoted by the symbol "T$" or sometimes "PT" (ISO currency code: TOP).

money.en: A good meal out costs T$30–50, a beer in a restaurant or bar about T$5–6, and car hire about T$50–60 a day.
money.es: Una buena comida fuera cuesta 30–50 T$, una cerveza en un restaurante o bar unos 5–6 T$ y alquilar un coche unos 50–60 T$ al día.
money.quote: A good meal out will cost T$30–50, a beer in a restaurant or bar costs about T$5–6, hiring a car is about T$50–60 a day

etiquette.en: Tongans observe the Sabbath, so on Sunday most people rest instead of working.
etiquette.es: Los tonganos respetan el sabbat, así que el domingo la mayoría descansa en vez de trabajar.
etiquette.quote: Tongans observe the Sabbath. This means that on Sunday, most people will rest instead of working.

etiquette.en: To get the greatest amount of respect, dress modestly.
etiquette.es: Para obtener el mayor respeto, vista con modestia.
etiquette.quote: To get the greatest amount of respect, dress modestly.

etiquette.en: Tongans frown upon gossip and consider it incredibly disrespectful.
etiquette.es: Los tonganos desaprueban los chismorreos y los consideran increíblemente irrespetuosos.
etiquette.quote: Tongans frown upon gossip and consider it incredibly disrespectful.

etiquette.en: Criticising the Tongan royal family as an outsider could very easily offend people.
etiquette.es: Criticar a la familia real tongana siendo extranjero podría ofender fácilmente a la gente.
etiquette.quote: Don't criticise or speak badly of the Tongan royal family; they are venerated in Tongan society and criticising them as an outsider could very easily offend people.

connectivity.en: You can buy a local SIM card at the airport and register it by giving your personal ID.
connectivity.es: Puede comprar una tarjeta SIM local en el aeropuerto y registrarla con su documento de identidad.
connectivity.quote: You can buy a local SIM card at the airport. You register it by giving your personal ID.

connectivity.en: Network coverage is usually reliable in towns but can be patchy in rural locations.
connectivity.es: La cobertura de red suele ser fiable en las ciudades, pero puede ser irregular en zonas rurales.
connectivity.quote: Network coverage is usually reliable in towns, but can be patchy in rural locations.

connectivity.en: Telecommunications are handled by two operators, Digicel Tonga and Tonga Communications Corporation.
connectivity.es: Las telecomunicaciones las gestionan dos operadores, Digicel Tonga y Tonga Communications Corporation.
connectivity.quote: Telecommunications in Tonga are handled by two operators; Digicel Tonga and Tonga Communications Corporation.
